ct_interaction_errors_desc: Run /triggers interactions errors naar see de errors that hebben been encountered.
ct_interaction_errors_info_desc: de following errors waren encountered when updating je application command chat triggers. If je need help resolving any of them, please stop door de [official support Server](https://discord.gg/Mewdeko).
ct_interaction_errors_none_desc: If je application command chat triggers zijn not showing up in discord, try restarting je client (ctrl+r op desktop, force-stopping en re-opening de app van settings op mobile). If je still do not see de triggers je hebben encountered an Fout met our command validation. Please report it in de [official support Server](https://discord.gg/Mewdeko).
ct_interaction_errors_title: OH geen! I cannot update je application command chat triggers!
ct_interaction_name_invalid: Interaction names must be less than 32 characters en not be entirely blank space. Slash command names can Alleen contain letters, numbers, en hyphens (-), in addition they must be allemaal lowercase. Read [Discord's official documentation](https://discord.com/developers/docs/interactions/application-commands#application-command-object-application-command-naming) voor more information. If je want naar change de interaction name zonder effecting normal trigger, run `/triggers interactions name`.
